title: E0013: Private method not being used
plain_english: This rule reports private methods that are declared in a class but never called within that class.
why_matters: Unused private methods are dead code. They add noise, make classes harder to understand, and can leave behind maintenance or testing overhead for logic that is no longer needed.
what_it_checks: Private methods declared in a class.
Method calls inside the class, such as `$this->methodName()`.
Reports private methods that are never referenced in the class.
